definitions.explanation: Changing from one musical key to another within a piece of music.

examples.japanese: サビで{転調|てんちょう}する{曲|きょく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many songs modulate at the chorus.

examples.japanese: {半音|はんおん}{上|うえ}に{転調|てんちょう}した。
この{曲|きょく}は{転調|てんちょう}が{劇的|げきてき}でかっこいい。
examples.english: This song has a dramatic key change that's really cool.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{転|てん} (change, turn) + {調|ちょう} (key, tone)

MUSICAL CONTEXT:
{転調|てんちょう} is a common technique in popular music, especially J-pop, where songs often modulate up by a half step or whole step in the final chorus to create a dramatic climax.

RELATED TERMS:
・{調|ちょう} - key (musical)
・{長調|ちょうちょう} - major key
・{短調|たんちょう} - minor key
・{半音|はんおん} - semitone/half step
・{全音|ぜんおん} - whole tone/whole step

COLLOCATIONS:
・{転調|てんちょう}する - to modulate
・{上|うえ}に{転調|てんちょう} - modulate up
・{下|した}に{転調|てんちょう} - modulate down
・{突然|とつぜん}の{転調|てんちょう} - sudden modulation
・{自然|しぜん}な{転調|てんちょう} - smooth/natural modulation
